name: Pontianak
description: Pontianak is the ghost of a woman who died during pregnancy or childbirth in Malay-Indonesian folklore. She appears as a beautiful long-haired woman in white whose form changes into a fanged, bloody monster when she attacks, and she primarily preys on men.

aliases.name: Langsuir
aliases.meaning: Closely related female ghost; in some traditions Pontianak is the stillborn child of Langsuir

origin: Throughout the Malay-Indonesian world: Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Brunei, southern Thailand, and the Malay diaspora.
